claims.text: The same editorial records its own disagreement with him: 'WE CANNOT wholly agree with the respected Vice Adm. R. H. Hillenkoetter (ret.) that the Air Force is deceiving the public' -- which preserves his position as well as the paper's.

claims.text: An Enquirer editorial of 4 March 1960, also held in CIA records, states that 'Admiral Hillenkoetter, former director of the Central Intelligence Agency, is a board member of the privately financed NICAP ... As such he has referred his conclusions to the Senate Space Committee, requesting an investigation.'
